caption:
Stay open to it coming in MAGICAL WAYS!!! 🤸✨🌀

I am very picky about what I want, but NOT about how it comes in….thats the magical part. You wouldn’t want to know anyway. Otherwise it’s predictable and BORING. 

Let the great conductor have her fun orchestrating this shit for you.
author: FLOSS
title: Stay Open to How the Universe Delivers
one_liner: Be specific about what you want, but stay open to unexpected ways it arrives.
key_points: Be picky about your desires but not about how they manifest
Trying to control the 'how' makes life predictable and boring
Surrender the delivery method — let the universe orchestrate it
Staying open invites magical, unexpected outcomes
